data.name: I18n_AgentCatalogIntro
data.value: These interfaces are safe Agent wrappers around Word operations. The model receives tool names and JSON arguments, not raw Word COM objects.

data.name: I18n_AgentCatalogContract
data.value: Call a tool by its exact name and provide only JSON properties declared in its schema. Document writes are governed by the Agent execution mode and may require confirmation.

data.name: I18n_AgentCatalogSafety
data.value: Effect labels are execution boundaries. Word reads and writes stay on Word's UI thread; network, local-process, and MCP calls are separately controlled.

data.name: I18n_AgentCatalogSkillRules
data.value: A local Skill should describe a repeatable workflow using only the tools above. It must not require raw COM, arbitrary scripts, shell commands, hidden network calls, or direct file manipulation. The Agent runtime still applies permissions and tracked-change rules.
